none: PAS NLM-234A11: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, probably of Tetricus I (271-274), possibly cf. Cunetio no. 2604. Obverse description: radiate bust probably cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [IMP TET]RICVS [PF AVG]. Reverse description: probably Pax standing left with vertical sceptre and right hand raised. Reverse inscription: possibly [PAX AVG]. Diameter: 20.8mm, Weight: 3.46gms, die axis: 6
